universities.name: Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli
universities.summary: IIM Tiruchirappalli is a public management institute established in 2011. Its degree portfolio includes residential MBAs in general management and human resources, a weekend MBA at the Chennai campus, and full-time and executive PhD routes. Programme format and applicant category determine the admissions route and costs.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Tiruchirappalli residential campus brings teaching, hostels, a Learning Resource Centre and sports facilities into the student day. The working-executive MBA is different: it runs face-to-face on weekends at the Chennai campus and is non-residential.
universities.cityProfile: The main institute is on the Tiruchirappalli–Pudukkottai road in Tamil Nadu. Residential MBA students study at Tiruchirappalli, while the working-executive MBA meets at the separate Chennai campus in K K Nagar. These are different study locations, so a Chennai weekend programme should not be confused with a residential place in Tiruchirappalli.
universities.practicalExposure: The general-management MBA combines core study and electives with case discussions, group work, simulations and a summer internship. Its Make a Difference project involves team-based work on a social issue. The HR MBA has a specialist human-resources focus within a management degree. These learning activities describe the curriculum, not a promise of employment or a particular salary.
universities.hostelOverview: The Tiruchirappalli hostels provide air-conditioned rooms with Wi-Fi and LAN access. Dedicated blocks accommodate women, and ground-floor rooms with attached bathrooms support residents with disabilities. The residential MBA arrangements do not extend automatically to the non-residential Chennai working-executive MBA.
universities.dietarySupport: Campus dining includes a mess and canteen block, a night canteen and a sandwich bar. Boarding is a separate expense under the overseas MBA fee policy. No specific dietary certification or allergen-free catering arrangement is established in the reviewed material.
universities.safetyOverview: The institute has an anti-ragging committee and an Internal Complaints Committee. These provide defined institutional channels for concerns; their existence is not a guarantee against incidents. The campus committee structure is distinct from emergency assistance.
universities.studentSupport: Students have access to the Learning Resource Centre and computing resources. Institutional support channels include public grievances, the Internal Complaints Committee and the SC/ST Cell. Hostel accessibility features include designated ground-floor accommodation for residents with disabilities.

faq.question: Which degree routes does IIM Tiruchirappalli offer?
faq.answer: The degree portfolio has three MBA routes: PGPM, PGPM-HR and the working-executive PGPBM in Chennai. It also includes full-time and executive PhD programmes. The programme listings here cover the two residential MBAs with verified overseas admissions policies.

faq.question: Are the residential MBA applications currently open?
faq.answer: The cited policies concern the 2026–28 batch, whose admissions cycle is closed. They do not establish a future application deadline or intake. The working-executive MBA has a separate admissions calendar.

faq.question: Who qualified for the 2026–28 overseas MBA category?
faq.answer: That category covered Indian and foreign nationals living, working or studying outside India throughout 2025. Candidates present or residing in India on the CAT 2025 examination date were excluded from that category.

faq.question: What did the overseas MBA fee include?
faq.answer: For 2026–28, the combined package was USD 32,000 for two years, covering tuition and specified institutional charges including hostel accommodation. Boarding, the refundable caution deposit, personal expenses and any applicable taxes were additional.

faq.question: How does the Chennai working-executive MBA differ?
faq.answer: PGPBM is a 21-month, face-to-face weekend programme at the Chennai campus, rather than a residential MBA at Tiruchirappalli. Its admissions route requires prior full-time work experience, and it does not offer formal placement assistance.

faq.question: What accommodation and dining facilities are available?
faq.answer: The Tiruchirappalli campus has air-conditioned hostel rooms with internet access, dedicated accommodation for women and accessible ground-floor rooms. Dining options include the mess, canteens and a sandwich bar; boarding is not included in the overseas MBA package.

faq.question: Does AMBA accreditation cover every doctoral route?
faq.answer: The independently verified AMBA profile lists three MBA programmes: PGPM, PGPM-HR and PGPBM. This badge is not presented as programme-specific accreditation of the institute’s doctoral research areas.
